build_flux2_transformer: build a Flux2Transformer2DModel DiT for image generation with configurable attention heads and modulation
create_flux2_attention: create a Flux2Attention module with fused QKV projections, RoPE embeddings, and concatenated text-image attention
build_flux2_feedforward: build a Flux2FeedForward block with merged linear projections and SwiGLU activation
create_flux2_modulation: create a Flux2Modulation layer that generates shift/scale/gate parameters from timestep embeddings
test_flux2_pos_embed: test a Flux2PosEmbed module that computes RoPE frequency cosines and sines from positional IDs
